entities.summary: Qabiao, Pu Peo or sometimes Laqua is a Kra language spoken by the Qabiao people in northern Vietnam and Yunnan, China. Alternative names for Qabiao include Kabeo, Ka Beo, Ka Bao, Ka Biao, Laqua, Pubiao and Pen Ti Lolo. The meaning of the name "Qabiao" is unknown.
